texts.en:
An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the [From.From.From.GetName] system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing massive subspace disturbances in the entire system.

These disturbances are localized around the entity itself and should disappear when it leaves the system. While it does not acknowledge hails, the entity is continuously emitting a complex pattern of tachyon pulses which appears to be a form of language. If our translation software is correct, it is saying, over and over:

"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."

label.en: This will interfere with ship systems.

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

texts.zh:
在与[vluur_system.GetName]星系中我方军队交战时，亚空间实体“弗雷尔”提高了其发送快子流的频率，但不停重复的信息与之前一样：

“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”

在受到致命一击的同时，这个实体自爆了，大爆炸使得整个恒星系中撒满了暗物质。
texts.en:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the [vluur_system.GetName] system, the subspace entity "VLUUR" increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."

When the final killing blow was delivered, the entity detonated in a massive explosion that showered the system in dark matter.

label.en: We shall collect what we can.

summary.text:
# 弗雷尔 / VLUUR

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany

## 如何开始 How it starts

首次接触 VLUUR（国家类型 vluur）时（on_first_contact）触发 galactic_features.421，并建立通讯。

First contact with VLUUR (country type vluur) (on_first_contact) triggers galactic_features.421 and establishes communications.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

421：一个强大的亚空间实体，不具敌意；选项“这会干扰舰船系统”。VLUUR 被摧毁时隐藏事件 422 清除风暴、给系统内最多4颗行星加上暗物质矿藏，并对默认国家和衰落帝国发出 423“VLUUR 的终结”，获得100暗物质。

421: a powerful subspace entity that is not hostile; option "This will interfere with ship systems". When VLUUR is destroyed hidden event 422 removes the storm, adds dark-matter deposits to up to four planets in the system and sends 423 "The End of VLUUR" to default countries and fallen empires, giving 100 dark matter.
